scope: UNREGISTERED developer-only, not WSP80 16-world scientific SELFTEST
hypothesis: Can direct numerical weight editing learn a history-conditioned causal dependency outside WSP81's 31-member trigger/offset hidden-state hypothesis family by choosing generic lagged Boolean features from paid observations, without hardcoding the new source equation into the learner?

source.private_rule: Visible state six binary bits; actions six. Every action flips its same-index visible state bit. Novel family additionally flips visible bit (action+secret_offset)%6 IF the previous TWO paid actions are equal and both exist; offset is hidden 1..5 chosen by SHA256('WSP82|DEV|seed|offset-v1') mod5+1. World initial state zeros, paid history empty; no reset. Control family has only base action bit flip. Learners see only (public_before,action,public_after,action_cost) and order, never private offset/source oracle.
source.fixed_action: For each seed and paid step [0,383], use SHA256('WSP82|DEV|seed|action|step') first 8 bytes %6, no tuning, independent of private physics.
source.evaluator: For each context independently initialize history with specified preceding public actions, and counterfactually evaluate every one of 64 public states times six actions. No arbitrary-state private oracle is available during fitting, weight editing or prediction freeze.

learners.new_programmed: Generic candidate Boolean temporal feature bank over current action, last action, penultimate action and equality primitives, including interaction gates; features are not expressed in terms of private offset or new-source rule. Select lowest-complexity exactly matching XOR residual for each output bit from paid trajectory; abstain when multiple minimal solutions give different prediction; compile recovered feature coefficients into numeric ReLU gates and cold-restorable weights.
learners.independent_symbolic: Independently coded same-expressivity Boolean-feature inference and confidence consensus from the identical paid ledger. If exact tie, do not call it numerical intelligence advantage.
learners.prior_WSP81: Source-blind old 31-mechanism learner from WSP81; catch incompatibility explicitly. No change to its source or algorithm.
learners.markov: Basic action-bit-flip predictor; expected negative control.
learners.memorization: Charged (public state, action, two prior actions) exact lookup, abstain when unseen/conflicting.
learners.recurrent_neural: Genuine fully trained three-restart Adam 25->32 ReLU->6 sigmoid model, including explicit history inputs (6 state,6 action,6 previous,6 penultimate,1 equality), original WSP77 frozen Adam optimizer, up to 6000 updates/restart, >=95% exact charged training accuracy target. If not converged report INCOMPLETE, not a matched strong neural loss.
learners.same_budget: All models receive exactly one 384-step continuously paid public source history per world; no free actions/truth/labels. No post-result changes.

freeze: Serialize and SHA256 bind every model's predictions, training/charge receipts and unlabeled confidences before ANY evaluator-private context transition truth is queried. Retain negative outcomes and separately report process CPU/wall/RSS.

budget.checks: focused new developer unit and full inherited suite, pinned G29 source atlas; no registered scientific run

decision: Pass only when all development thresholds pass, else NEGATIVE; never repair a failed scientific outcome by changing source/protocol/seeds after first execution. Implementation/CI bugs can be fixed with original prereg unchanged and all provisional outcomes preserved.
limit: Source family uses a known synthetic six-bit simulator; researcher designed a feature bank containing a generic equality-of-lags operator. This is not unrestricted program synthesis, novel physics discovery, robust life-long learning, language or AGI. Strong recurrence baseline must be trained (or its failure clearly reported), independent symbolic control expected to tie.
